sutta: 10.6 on one occasion the verbal anuruda was dwelling at savarti indeed his growth not up in deeper now on that occasion the verbal anuruda having risen at the first flush of dawn was reciting stanzas of dhamma then the female yaka piyangkara's mother crushed her little child thus do not make a sound yankara among recites dharma stanzas having understood a dhamma standard we might practice for our welfare let us refrain from harming living beings let us not speak a deliberate lie we should train ourselves in virtue perhaps we will be free from the goblin realm at the end of the sukta so you see this yaka this yaka she actually this yaka she was in a low very low uh deva realm sometimes they are known as earthbound devas so they live around us sometimes like our what we call that earth spirit mountain spirit uh so when the dhamma is recited or the dharma is taught some of them are interested to hear like in this case this diankala's mother she asked her child to keep quiet let's listen to the dhamma so she knows about precepts and all that not harming harmony not harming living beings not to tell lies etc so that's why wherever amongst uh or our lay people what is the dhamma well and these devas are happy they'll come and protect
